about: The P9-01 magazine in the hand while it is loaded (gun/p9_01_mag_load; docs/native_guns/magazine_system_v1.md 4): the held magazine item as NativeMagazineRendering draws it, straightened (item block units: the magazine pivot at (0.5, 0.635, 0.5), the lips up, the front at -z). Scale as the P9-01 prop, so it is the gun's own magazine size. Points from tools/build-p9-01-magazine.mjs's straightened mesh: top (the feed lips, where a round is pressed in), grip (the middle of the body), base (the floorplate), hold_l (the left palm on the magazine's left side, low: the palm is 2 px off a 4 px hand's middle, so it rests on the side instead of swallowing the magazine). The extended magazine is held at the same points. Symmetry x (the magazine looks the same across its width), so a right-handed player's mirrored loading keeps it upright in the right hand.
